title: Cold and Windy Day
text:
Today the weather is cold and windy. The sky is grey. It is raining a little. Ann wears a warm coat and a red hat.

Tomorrow the sun will come out. It will be warm and sunny. Ann and her dad will go to the park. They like sunny days.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What will the weather be tomorrow?
Why does Ann wear a warm coat?
options: Because she is going to bed

questions.text: How does Ann probably feel about tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: with a lot of wind blowing
a long warm piece of clothing worn outside

paragraph_translations: Сьогодні холодно й вітряно. Небо сіре. Трохи накрапає дощ. Анна носить тепле пальто й червоний капелюх.
Завтра вийде сонце. Буде тепло і сонячно. Анна з татом підуть у парк. Їм подобаються сонячні дні.
